identity.title: Verify ROI fixture transform and overlay coordinate meaning

origin.summary: 2D-030 requires a focused source and fixture contract for ROI, affine transforms, coordinate frames, overlays, and exported metrics.

state.current_summary: 2D-030 coordinate meaning is verified through the existing fixture/affine, ROI, metric, overlay, XML, and Run History owners; no new coordinate or calibration abstraction was added.

objective.summary: Prove that supported ROI and fixture transforms preserve metric, overlay, and export coordinates, while singular, out-of-ROI, missing-calibration, and unsupported anisotropic/world-calibration cases fail or remain N/A without scalar mm/px inference.
constraints: Reuse the existing fixture/affine, ROI, coordinate-frame, overlay, and export owners; do not add a new coordinate abstraction, calibration service, or algorithm.
Use known-point/known-length synthetic fixtures and preserve existing frame fields and XML/save-reopen semantics.
Use isolated evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev; do not touch Original, release, deploy, hardware, or external systems.

criteria.text: Identity, translation, rotation, and flip cases preserve the declared metric, overlay, and export coordinate frame within the existing tolerance.
Singular transforms, ROI-outside inputs, missing calibration, and unsupported anisotropic/world-calibration cases fail closed or remain explicitly N/A without fabricated scalar mm/px results.
Focused Debug/Release contract and documentation record the existing owner/call path, save/reopen boundary, and unverified WPF/render/runtime limits.

evidence.observation: Debug coordinate contract passed for identity, translation, 90-degree rotation, horizontal flip, fixture ROI translation/failure gates, and singular destination rejection; XML reopen, affine metrics, point overlays, Run History metrics, and overlay export were retained.
Release coordinate contract passed with the same matrix, overlay, save/reopen, report, fixture, and fail-closed observations as Debug.

Existing affine-transform, detected-point Affine, ROI meaning, and finite PIXELPERMM contracts all exited 0 in both configurations; invalid scalar calibration remained pixel-only/no-mm through the existing contract.
Documentation records the current owner/call path, mutable ROI/metric writers, save/reopen and export boundary, next 2D-031 priority, and the unverified WPF EXE/theme/DPI/monitor/hardware limits.

events.summary: Close 2D-030 as a contract-only slice: retain the existing fixture translation-only boundary and SDK Affine owner, record pixel-coordinate persistence/export evidence, and leave WPF/runtime qualification outside this slice.
All 2D-030 criteria have active Debug/Release evidence and durable documentation; the remaining WPF/runtime qualification is explicitly outside this slice.
